author: R Madhav
title: Worst digital wallet
review_text: I had been using esewa right from the beginning, as an early digital wallet its services were fine till few years back, but nowadays there is no single transaction that went smoothly, every transaction show some kind of error but the balance gets deducted, when tried to report dispute they ask for screenshot of error! Dispute never gets resolved and the unprofessional and unfriendly behavior of the costumer service representative is frustrating.  I am not using esewa anymore.
